title: HyperKKL: Enabling Non-Autonomous State Estimation through Dynamic Weight Conditioning
abstract: arXiv:2602.22630v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper proposes HyperKKL, a novel learning approach for designing Kazantzis-Kravaris/Luenberger (KKL) observers for non-autonomous nonlinear systems. While KKL observers offer a rigorous theoretical framework by immersing nonlinear dynamics into a stable linear latent space, its practical realization relies on solving Partial Differential Equations (PDE) that are analytically intractable. Current existing learning-based approximations of the KKL observer are mostly designed for autonomous systems, failing to generalize to driven dynamics without expensive retraining or online gradient updates. HyperKKL addresses this by employing a hypernetwork architecture that encodes the exogenous input signal to instantaneously generate the parameters of the KKL observer, effectively learning a family of immersion maps parameterized by the external drive. translated_title: HyperKKL：通过动态权重调节实现非自治系统的状态估计
translated_abstract: 本文提出了HyperKKL，一种用于设计非自治非线性系统的Kazantzis-Kravaris/Luenberger（KKL）观测器的新型学习方法。尽管KKL观测器通过将非线性动力学浸入一个稳定的线性潜空间而提供了严谨的理论框架，但其实际实现依赖于求解在解析上难以处理的偏微分方程（PDE）。现有的基于学习的KKL观测器近似方法大多针对自治系统设计，在不进行昂贵的重新训练或在线梯度更新的情况下，无法泛化到受外部驱动的动力学系统。HyperKKL通过采用超网络架构来解决这一问题：该架构对外生输入信号进行编码，从而即时生成KKL观测器的参数，有效地学习了一族由外部驱动信号参数化的浸入映射。我们针对课程学习策略对该方法进行了严格的评估……
tldr: 本文提出HyperKKL，利用超网络架构根据外生输入信号动态生成KKL观测器参数，使基于学习的观测器无需重新训练即可泛化到非自治非线性系统。
en_tdlr: HyperKKL employs a hypernetwork that conditions on exogenous input signals to instantaneously generate KKL observer parameters, enabling learning-based state estimation for non-autonomous nonlinear systems without retraining.
